title: MotionByDk AE Workflow Pro v3.7.0 Suite Released!
message: Major update with Liquid Glass Native Plugin, 7-Day Free Trial Engine, and Cloudflare D1/R2 License Integration.
changelog: Added Liquid Glass native plugin (ToolsForMotion) with 1-click macOS & Windows installers
Integrated 7-Day Free Trial Engine with persistent local tamper protection
Added Cloudflare D1 Cloud Licensing & 2-PC hardware activation
Upgraded 3D Spatial Carousel Suite with 5 visual layouts & real-time AE preview
Upgraded macOS Mouse Dock magnification effect with realistic spring physics
Enhanced Bezier Graph Editor curve library with instant ease ramps
